cause.summary: Our keyer, in every affected cell; never the painting. Each shaft is painted whole and inside its cell, but cast through with the key (green sheets: a dark green shaft about (3, 122, 0); the Wolf Rider front's lighter blue sheet: a navy shaft about (14, 41, 118) with a steel tip). key.py read that as part key (alpha 0.2 to 0.6), its 1 px erosion took the rest, and slice.py (mask at alpha 0.35) dropped the remains as specks, so the pennon and the tip were left floating above the hand.

ruledOut.slicing / cell windows: no frame touches its slice window or the sheet edge, before or after (frames JSON overlaps, boxes)
ruledOut.cell crop: cut() keeps the mask plus 2 px; the boxes simply ended where the keyed shaft did
ruledOut.ground-anchor framing: nothing cropped; the restored lances would have moved some anchors (up to 16.6 px), so the shipped anchors are carried
ruledOut.fringe and edge passes: ad_rimfix, the nogreen keycast and the blue edge pass change colour only, never alpha
ruledOut.packer and bundle: cpack premul_resize and the bundle pages take every frame whole (frame rects are the full cutouts)
ruledOut.painting: no shaft runs out of its cell in any of the four sheets; no generation needed
